_provenance: PARTIAL LIST, and thinner than most. Transcribed from the terms printed on Max's own
Super Gift Card leaflet, gc-max-super.pdf (SharedMedia/14807), fetched 2026-07-29.
Super Gift Card is an experiences product rather than a retail one — hotels, spa,
restaurants, shows, tours, workshops, flights. The leaflet presents those merchants
purely as logo images, and its readable text is almost entirely category headings. The
handful of brands below are the only ones named in prose, each because it carries a
condition, so each is genuinely accepted.
This is a much smaller fraction of the real network than the max_gift list is of its
own, which is why the partial flag matters more here, not less.
Wolt, smartair, holidayfinder and YANGO DELI are marked online-redeemable: the terms
state those are bought as coupon codes through the MYGIFT app or by entering the card
as a payment method, rather than in a shop.
